#!/bin/sh
source $HOME/.bash_profile;

cd $AC_SYSTEM/interfaces/RAPT/scripts

GATEWAY="/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/Raptor/in"
DATE=`date +%Y-%m-%d`
if [ ! $UseBusinessDate == 0 ]; then
  DATE=$(echo $BusinessDate | awk '{ print substr($0,1,4)"-"substr($0,5,2)"-"substr($0,7,2) }')
fi
TIME="16:00:00"
HOST="etrading.uk.acme.com"
PORT="443"

function getRaptorFile
{
  CONFIG_ID=$1
  FILENAME="RAPTOR_${DATE//-/}${TIME//:/}_${CONFIG_ID}_RAPTOR_SWAP.csv" 

  ./getRaptorRestCurveData.pl ../config/RaptorSnapCurveConfig.xml $CONFIG_ID -d $DATE -t $TIME -h $HOST -p $PORT -o CSV > $GATEWAY/$FILENAME
}

if [ $Live -eq 1 ]
then
  getRaptorFile EUR-LIVE
  getRaptorFile USD-LIVE
  getRaptorFile GBP-LIVE
else
  getRaptorFile EUR
  getRaptorFile USD
  getRaptorFile GBP
fi
